messages:
zoe: Quick thread for PR #5798. We're adding a compact worked example showing: 1) how to compute allowance for a minutes window, 2) a tiny Rust SDK snippet (we don't have many Rust examples), 3) one-line migration guidance for legacy meter headers, and 4) a short alert rule sample for the dashboard. Keep each part extremely short. cc @arjun @maria
arjun: I can do the Rust snippet. Will keep it 5 lines and show flooring behavior. Also include a one-line comment about rounding vs display.
maria: I'll add the migration line and a brief note about alerts using percent_of_daily. Also remind readers that burst credits are excluded until consumed.
l10n-bot: l10n-check queued on PR #5798. Please mark locale-sensitive examples for review.
arjun: Rust draft (tiny):```rust
// compute floored allowance for minutes
fn allowance(per_min: f64, minutes: u32) -> u32 {
    (per_min * minutes as f64).floor() as u32
}
// example: allowance(250.0, 4) -> 1000
```
zoe: Perfect. For the alert rule, keep YAML minimal and customer-facing. Example:```yaml
when: usage.percent_of_daily >= 85
window: 1h
action: send:billing-alerts
notes: percent calc rounds to nearest int; burst credits excluded until consumed
```
maria: Migration one-liner: "If you used the legacy meter header, map it to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute allowances from per_min/per_day fields."
zoe: UX callout (one short sentence): "UI shows costs with two decimals, but enforcement uses integer token math (floored allowances)."
ops-bot: Reminder: strip internal console links from public docs; use /docs/usage-dashboard for panel links.
l10n-bot: Flagged locale-sensitive dollar/euro examples for translation; please avoid hardcoded locale strings in snippets.
zoe: Action items: arjun - push Rust snippet; maria - add migration line + alert note; i'll run a quick lint and merge after l10n clears. Thanks! :rocket:
